User-Restricted.description:
HMRC supports OAuth 2.0 for authenticating user-restricted API requests using an OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token in the
AUTHORIZATION header.
See https://developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk/api-documentation/docs/authorisation/user-restricted-endpoints for details.

scopes.read:native-apps-api-orchestration: Expose API to provide data the apps need at the time that they start up

info.description:
### What is this API for?
The API provides data that the mobile apps need at startup. It aggregates information from
a number of other api endpoints.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the startup data that the mobile apps use to initialize themselves. The service will use the authentication token to identify the NINO for the user that using the app. The json response will contain keys for `helpToSave` and `taxCreditsRenewals`. The values for each of these is the json returned from the relevant service. The response will also contain a `features` key that references a set of feature flags.
